units.source_text: 他没有和她一道儿去死。

en.t: He did not go to die together with her.

units.source_text: 他对自己一根手指头都没碰过她这件事感到满意。

en.t: He was satisfied that he had never laid even a finger on her.

units.source_text: 她漫不经心的时常和他聊天，

en.t: She would often chat with him in an offhand way,

units.source_text: 并且带了一瓶氰化钾给他，

en.t: and she brought him a bottle of potassium cyanide,

units.source_text: 还说：“有了这个，我们就都安心了。”

en.t: and said, "With this, we can both feel at ease."
